question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The actress is very __________ and takes pride in her appearance all the time.
solution:
The correct word is**: vain.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is describing someone who takes excessive pride in their appearance, which is the definition of **"vain."** (दंभी)
 
• **"Vain" **means having or showing an excessively high opinion of one's appearance, abilities, or worth.
 
 
• **​For example:** She was vain about her looks, spending hours in front of the mirror.
 
 

Thus, the complete sentence is: *"The actress is very vain and takes pride in her appearance all the time."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Vein"** is a blood vessel or a distinctive style. (नस)

 
 
• **​****For example:** The nurse found a vein to draw blood from the patient's arm.
 
 
 
• **"Wane" **means to decrease in size, extent, or degree. (पतन)
 
 
• **​****For example:** His interest in the hobby began to wane after a few months.
 
 
 
• **"Vane"** refers to a device that shows the direction of the wind, typically a weather vane. (फलक)
 
 
• **​****For example:** The weather vane showed that the wind was coming from the north.
